```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
```

```{python}
ames = pd.read_csv("~/Desktop/GSB 544/Notes/Data/AmesHousing.csv", sep=",")
```

```{python}
X = ames.drop(columns='SalePrice')
y=ames['SalePrice']
```

### Using only Size and number of rooms: 

```{python}
ct_twovars = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("dropstuff", "passthrough", ["Lot Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"]) #"passthrough" just keeps the lot area and TotRms AbcGrd can also use StandardScalar
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("select correct vars", ct_twovars), 
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
y_preds = lr_size_num_pipeline.predict(X)
r2_score(y, y_preds)
```

### Using size, number of rooms, and building type 

```{python}
ct_dummify_and_select = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
  ("select columns", "passthrough", ["Lot Area", "TotRms AbvGrd"])], 
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("dummify and select", ct_dummify_and_select),
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```

```{python}
y_preds_2 = lr_size_num_bldg_pipeline.predict(X)
r2_score(y, y_preds_2)
```

### Using size and building type, and their interaction
```{python}
ct_dummy_get = ColumnTransformer(
  [("dummify", OneHotEncoder(sparse_output = False), ["Bldg Type"]),
  ("select columns", "passthrough", ["Lot Area"])], 
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
ct_int_size_bldg = ColumnTransformer(
  [
    ("interaction 1Fam", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_1Fam"]),
    ("interaction TwhseE", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_TwnhsE"]),
    ("interaction Twnhs", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_Twnhs"]), 
    ("interaction Duplex", PolynomialFeatures(interaction_only = True), ["Lot Area", "dummify__Bldg Type_Duplex"])
  ],
  remainder = "drop"
).set_output(transform = "pandas")
```

```{python}
lr_size_bldg_pipeline = Pipeline(
    [("dummify and select", ct_dummy_get),
    ("interaction", ct_int_size_bldg), 
    ("linear regression", LinearRegression())]
)
```

```{python}
lr_size_bldg_pipeline.fit(X,y)
```
